acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS offers factor, path, and per-construct PCA weighting; standardized, unstandardized, and mean-centered results; and standard or per-indicator initial outer weights.
acceptance_criteria: The settings contract exposes exactly factor, path, and PCA weighting and exactly standardized, unstandardized, and mean-centered result types.
Standard initialization assigns +1 to every indicator; individual initialization persists one explicit starting weight per indicator.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page says iteration count is fixed in SmartPLS 4 while also noting that zero iterations returns sum scores; the current reachability of that zero-iteration route is not established by the page.
acceptance_criteria: A dated SmartPLS desktop fixture records whether zero iterations can be selected in the current UI or another supported execution path and records the resulting method label.
Until that fixture exists, sum-scores reachability remains an explicit open detail and is not inferred from the documentation note.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: path weighting, standardized results, and +1 initial outer weights are defaults; SmartPLS 4 fixes the maximum at 3,000 iterations and the outer-weight stop criterion at 1e-7.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh current-version recipe resolves to path weighting, standardized results, standard +1 initialization, 3,000 maximum iterations, and a 1e-7 stop criterion.
The fixed iteration and stop values are stored in Run Details even when they are not user-editable.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the algorithm estimates a specified PLS path model with adjacent construct scores and indicator blocks using Mode A single regressions or Mode B multiple regression; path weighting is described as generally applicable to all PLS path-model specifications.
acceptance_criteria: Microcases with a Mode A block and with a full-rank Mode B block compile to the documented outer-weight regressions and retain the specified structural adjacency.
Changing one structural path changes the affected inner approximation and downstream estimates without changing unrelated presentation objects.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate current eligibility for cycles, single-indicator constructs, controls, interactions, higher-order constructs, or other difficult diagram shapes.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app model-shape matrix records acceptance or rejection and the exact diagnostic for every difficult PLS shape in the finalization corpus.
No shape is marked supported solely from the page's general-applicability wording.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the algorithm operates on observed indicator values indexed by case and estimates construct scores from indicator data and the specified path model.
acceptance_criteria: The runner binds every scientific indicator to an observed data column and records the case count used to calculate scores.
An unbound indicator is rejected before iteration begins with an object-specific diagnostic.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: this page does not define missing-value policies, categorical-scale eligibility, matrix-input support, or file-import behavior for the PLS algorithm.
acceptance_criteria: Separate official data-workflow captures record every current input and missing-data choice before those choices are claimed as algorithm parity.
The PLS core fragment does not infer support for covariance, correlation, ordinal, or silently imputed inputs.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: during stages 1 and 2 manifest and latent scores are treated as deviations from their means, and each updated outside approximation is scaled to unit variance.
acceptance_criteria: A hand-calculated fixture confirms mean-deviation treatment in stages 1 and 2 and unit-variance construct-score normalization after every outside update.
Mode A uses indicator-on-inside-approximation regressions and Mode B uses inside-approximation-on-indicators multiple regression.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the three stages yield construct scores and outer weights, path coefficients and loadings, and location parameters; result scaling may be standardized, unstandardized, or mean-centered.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result contains stable typed tables for scores, outer weights, loadings, structural paths, and applicable location parameters.
The selected result type changes the numerical scale and intercept/location output as documented and is preserved in archive and export.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate every current SmartPLS result table, diagnostic, ordering rule, precision rule, or table identifier.
acceptance_criteria: A dated complete-results capture enumerates table names, columns, ordering, precision, missing-value display, and result navigation.
The documented core outputs do not by themselves close full result-surface parity.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official algorithm page does not specify a required chart inventory or chart interaction behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app capture records every PLS algorithm chart, its source table, controls, defaults, and export behavior; an empty inventory must be evidenced rather than assumed.
Every captured chart is tested against its source analytical cells.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: iteration ends when the change in outer weights is below 1e-7 or when 3,000 iterations are reached, and reaching the maximum rather than the stop criterion must be detectable when reviewing results.
acceptance_criteria: A forced nonconvergence fixture records maximum-iteration termination distinctly from convergence and cannot be presented as an ordinary converged result.
Run Details record iteration count, terminal reason, and final outer-weight change.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define current diagnostics for singular Mode B blocks, zero-variance indicators, invalid data, or other inadmissible inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Dated live-app fixtures capture the result or exact diagnostic for every adversarial core-model case in the finalization corpus.
No undocumented retry, pseudoinverse, zero substitution, or partial-result behavior is inferred.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: estimation initializes outer weights, iterates inner weights, inside approximation, provisional outer weights and normalized outside approximation, then estimates paths/loadings and location parameters.
acceptance_criteria: A trace fixture records the documented stage order and proves that Stage 2 and Stage 3 consume the converged Stage 1 scores.
The saved recipe and result preserve the selected weighting, scaling, and initialization choices.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify the complete current desktop click path, preflight sequence, progress states, cancellation behavior, or save/export workflow.
acceptance_criteria: A packaged live-app workflow capture records setup, run, progress, cancellation, results, save/reopen, and export actions on the frozen SmartPLS version.
Product parity remains open until those steps are represented in the broader workflow acceptance pack.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: a weighting tab presents a combo box for choosing the dataset's sampling-weight variable; selecting it automatically applies WPLS.
acceptance_criteria: The settings contract binds exactly one dataset column as a sampling weight and persists its stable column identity.
Selecting a weight changes the estimator to WPLS without requiring a separate scientific-model edit.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not state accepted numeric type, normalization rule, range, missing marker behavior, or whether a user may explicitly choose no weight after opening the tab.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app fixture records accepted weight values, normalization, missing-value behavior, and the no-weight state.
Sampling, frequency, and case weights are not treated as interchangeable without official evidence.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page explains selection but does not identify the current default combo-box value or any default weight normalization.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh-dialog live-app capture records the default weighting-tab state and the resulting estimator when the user makes no selection.
No WPLS default is entered into the parity contract until that current-version capture exists.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the weighting option appears for PLS, PLSc, and other algorithms that build on PLS or PLSc; absence of the weighting tab means WPLS is unavailable for that algorithm.
acceptance_criteria: PLS and PLSc fixtures can bind a sampling weight and compile to their weighted estimator variants.
A method without documented weighting support cannot accept a weight merely because the dataset contains a candidate column.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate every current downstream algorithm and difficult model shape for which the weighting tab appears.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app compatibility matrix records weighting-tab presence for every active PLS/PLSc-derived workflow and representative difficult model shape.
Uncaptured algorithms remain unsupported rather than being inferred from the phrase 'builds on PLS or PLSc'.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the imported dataset must contain a user-created sampling or post-stratification weight for every observation.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight verifies a one-to-one weight-to-observation binding and records the selected variable with the analytical sample.
The product never fabricates or estimates sampling weights during WPLS setup.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: zero, negative, nonfinite, missing, constant, extremely unbalanced, and filtered-out weights are not specified on the page.
acceptance_criteria: Dated current-version fixtures capture acceptance or the exact diagnostic for every adversarial weight vector in the qualification corpus.
No invalid-weight repair or normalization behavior is inferred from general sampling-weight guidance.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: WPLS incorporates sampling weights through weighted means or variances, weighted correlations, and weighted regressions on the observed-variable data.
acceptance_criteria: Hand-calculated weighted-moment and weighted-regression microcases match the estimator's values before iterative PLS estimation.
Changing only the selected sampling weights changes the weighted correlations/regressions while preserving scientific model identity.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: selecting the weight variable yields weighted PLS results and all subsequent supported PLS computations draw on those sampling weights.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result identifies WPLS and the selected weight variable and never labels a weighted estimate as an ordinary unweighted PLS estimate.
Every supported downstream result links to the same weight binding and analytical sample.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate WPLS-specific tables, weight diagnostics, effective-sample summaries, or provenance fields shown in current results.
acceptance_criteria: A dated complete-results capture enumerates every WPLS-specific table, label, diagnostic, and export field.
The generic statement 'weighted PLS results' does not close semantic export parity.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official WPLS page does not specify charts or weighted chart behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app capture records every WPLS chart and whether its source values use sampling weights; an empty inventory must be evidenced.
Any chart export reproduces the same weighted analytical values as its source table.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: when an algorithm has no weighting tab, WPLS is not available for that algorithm.
acceptance_criteria: An unsupported method/weight combination is blocked before execution with the method and corrective action identified.
The runner cannot receive a hidden weight parameter for an unsupported algorithm.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define current error messages, cancellation behavior, or numerical failure handling for invalid or extreme weights.
acceptance_criteria: A live-app adversarial fixture ledger records the exact outcome for missing, nonfinite, nonpositive, and high-leverage weights.
No silent clipping, absolute-value conversion, or unweighted fallback is accepted.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the researcher creates weights before import, selects the weighting variable while running a supported PLS/PLSc-based algorithm, and SmartPLS applies WPLS to subsequent computations.
acceptance_criteria: An end-to-end fixture imports a preexisting weight column, selects it, runs WPLS, then runs one supported downstream procedure with the same weight provenance.
Save/reopen and export preserve the selected weight column and weighted method identity.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not document the current complete click path, preflight summary, weight preview, progress, cancellation, or result-navigation sequence.
acceptance_criteria: A packaged current-version workflow capture records those desktop states and their accessible labels.
The documented combo-box instruction alone does not close the product workflow obligation.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: Initial calculations chooses either the path model as specified or an all-latent-variables-connected score model; the underlying PLS settings still apply and no other correction parameters are required.
acceptance_criteria: The PLSc settings schema has an explicit two-value initial-calculations enum and embeds the applicable PLS settings contract.
All-LV initialization changes only the score-generation adjacency used before correction and is recorded in the recipe.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page recommends connecting all latent variables for more stable scores but does not state which Initial calculations option is the current SmartPLS default.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh-dialog live-app capture records the selected Initial calculations value and all inherited PLS defaults.
The documented recommendation is not encoded as a default without that capture.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: PLSc corrects correlations among reflectively measured constructs so composite PLS estimates approximate a common-factor model.
acceptance_criteria: A reflective common-factor fixture receives the correction and returns disattenuated construct relationships.
The compiler identifies which constructs are eligible for correction rather than applying it blindly to every variable.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate support for mixed reflective/formative models, single-indicator constructs, interactions, higher-order constructs, controls, or other difficult shapes.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-version model-shape matrix records the outcome and exact diagnostic for each difficult PLSc fixture.
No mixed-model eligibility is inferred from the general description of reflectively specified constructs.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: PLSc is a correction applied to standard PLS-SEM results and its initial calculation generates latent-variable scores from the PLS model.
acceptance_criteria: PLSc consumes the same bound indicator observations and analytical sample as its linked initial PLS estimation.
Changing the data or missing-data recipe invalidates both initial scores and corrected estimates.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: this page does not specify matrix inputs, scale types, missing-data options, weights, or minimum sample/indicator requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Separate dated official captures enumerate current PLSc data and weight policies before those combinations enter the parity gate.
No input policy is inherited merely because PLSc starts from PLS results.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: after the initial PLS calculation, PLSc uses a correction-for-attenuation procedure to adjust correlations among reflectively measured constructs; all-LV connectivity may be used to stabilize initial scores.
acceptance_criteria: A transparent oracle fixture verifies the documented correction-for-attenuation from the same initial PLS result.
Specified-path and all-LV initial calculations produce separately identifiable score-generation plans.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: PLSc produces corrected, disattenuated construct correlations and parameter estimates intended to be consistent with a common-factor model for reflective constructs.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result labels corrected PLSc estimates distinctly from uncorrected PLS estimates and retains their shared run lineage.
Changing correction eligibility changes only affected corrected parameters and downstream results.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate every PLSc table, quality criterion, ordering rule, precision rule, or comparison with initial PLS values.
acceptance_criteria: A dated complete-results capture enumerates all PLSc tables, columns, identifiers, warnings, and exports.
The documented correction purpose alone does not close complete-results parity.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official PLSc page does not specify charts or chart behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-version capture enumerates PLSc charts and their corrected source tables; an empty inventory must be evidenced.
Chart exports preserve the PLSc method identity and corrected numerical values.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define diagnostics for ineligible measurement models, invalid reliability corrections, non-positive-definite corrected matrices, initial PLS nonconvergence, or inadmissible estimates.
acceptance_criteria: A dated adversarial live-app ledger captures the result or exact diagnostic for each PLSc correction failure scenario.
No clipping, absolute-value conversion, identity fallback, or silent return of uncorrected PLS results is accepted.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the researcher selects the Initial calculations strategy, checks the underlying PLS settings, runs the initial PLS estimation, and applies/evaluates the PLSc correction step by step.
acceptance_criteria: An end-to-end fixture links the initial PLS result, correction configuration, corrected PLSc result, archive, and export without recomputing hidden inputs.
Run Details expose both the initial-calculation strategy and the underlying PLS settings.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not document every current setup screen, warning, progress state, cancellation route, result tab, or export action.
acceptance_criteria: A packaged current-version live-app capture records the complete PLSc workflow and accessible control names.
Step-by-step support in the page is not treated as a complete UI specification.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: PCA has standardized outcomes only, based on the indicator correlation matrix, and uses an eigenvalue threshold of 1 as the component-retention decision criterion.
acceptance_criteria: The parity settings contract exposes standardized correlation-matrix PCA only and records the eigenvalue-greater-than-or-equal-to-1 retention rule.
No unstandardized result type is offered as official PCA parity.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: standardized correlation-matrix outcomes are both the default and the only PCA result type, with eigenvalue 1 as the retention criterion.
acceptance_criteria: A new PCA recipe deterministically stores standardized/correlation-matrix mode and the eigenvalue-1 criterion without an alternative hidden default.
Save/reopen and export reproduce that method configuration exactly.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS supports graphical PCA models as exploratory analysis within both PLS-SEM and CB-SEM projects, transforming observed indicators into uncorrelated components.
acceptance_criteria: A graphical PCA fixture binds a declared set of observed indicators and remains executable in both PLS-SEM and CB-SEM project contexts.
PCA relations are not silently reinterpreted as latent-factor loadings or PLS structural paths.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify minimum/maximum indicators, overlapping indicator sets, multiple PCA blocks, structural attachments, or other graphical restrictions.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app shape matrix records acceptance or the exact diagnostic for each PCA graph boundary in the qualification corpus.
No graph constraint is invented from the generic graphical-model statement.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: PCA uses observed indicator variables and their correlation matrix to reduce a dataset into fewer components.
acceptance_criteria: The analytical input records the exact indicator set, valid-case policy, and correlation matrix used for eigenvalue decomposition.
Reordering indicators preserves aligned eigenvalues and sign/orientation-adjusted component results.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define raw-versus-matrix input choices, missing-value treatment, categorical scales, weights, or constant-indicator handling.
acceptance_criteria: Dated current-version fixtures enumerate every accepted input type and missing-data choice and record constant-variable behavior.
Correlation-matrix computation is not evidence that user-supplied matrix input is supported.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: standardized indicator correlations undergo eigenvalue decomposition to produce uncorrelated principal components ordered by captured variance.
acceptance_criteria: A hand-calculated correlation-matrix fixture reproduces eigenvalues, orthogonal component directions up to sign, and explained-variance ordering.
Positive affine rescaling of an indicator leaves correlation-based PCA results unchanged after orientation alignment.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: PCA reports standardized uncorrelated components that retain as much variance as possible, with eigenvalue 1 used to decide how many components to retain.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result stores eigenvalues, explained-variance quantities, retained-component decisions, and component coefficients/scores where produced by the qualified contract.
The retained count changes deterministically when an eigenvalue crosses the threshold of 1.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate exact table names, loadings/score tables, total/cumulative variance columns, ordering, precision, or export structure.
acceptance_criteria: A dated complete-results capture records every PCA table, identifier, cell meaning, ordering, and export field.
Only tables evidenced by that capture enter the full surface-parity assertion.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official PCA page does not specify scree plots, loading plots, score plots, or any other chart inventory and controls.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app capture enumerates every PCA chart, axis/data mapping, component selector, default, and export behavior; an empty inventory must be evidenced.
Each captured visualization round-trips its analytical source data.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define behavior for fewer than two usable variables, zero variance, perfect collinearity, non-positive-definite correlations, missingness, or numerical eigenvalue ties.
acceptance_criteria: A dated adversarial live-app ledger captures a result or exact diagnostic for every listed matrix pathology.
The qualified implementation returns a deterministic oriented solution or a typed failure, never NaN leakage or an unexplained component drop.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: researchers create a graphical PCA model inside a PLS-SEM or CB-SEM project and estimate it by eigenvalue decomposition as exploratory data analysis before or alongside SEM.
acceptance_criteria: An end-to-end fixture authors the PCA graph, binds indicators, estimates, saves/reopens, and exports the same component solution in both project contexts.
The PCA run remains a distinct exploratory result and does not silently mutate the SEM model.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify current authoring controls, calculation menu placement, result navigation, dataset generation, or export actions.
acceptance_criteria: A packaged current-version workflow capture records the complete PCA desktop journey and accessible control names.
The graphical-model statement alone does not close current workflow parity.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: settings include subsample count, parallel processing, percentile/studentized/BCa confidence intervals, one- or two-sided testing, significance level, and random or fixed RNG seed.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe stores subsamples, processing mode, interval method, test side, significance level, seed mode, and fixed seed value when applicable.
Percentile, studentized, and BCa are independent selectable methods and one- versus two-sided tests alter the recorded inference contract.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS defaults to 10,000 subsamples and percentile confidence intervals; the page does not state current defaults for parallel processing, test type, significance level, or seed mode.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh recipe resolves to 10,000 subsamples and percentile intervals.
Every other default remains explicitly unresolved until a current live-app capture supplies it.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: current defaults for parallel processing, one/two-sided testing, significance level, random/fixed seed mode, and fixed-seed value are not specified by the page.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh-dialog dated capture records every unspecified default and its disabled/enabled conditions.
SmartPLS 3's random-seed behavior is retained as historical context only and is not assumed to be the SmartPLS 4 default.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: each bootstrap subsample re-estimates a PLS path model and supports inference for parameter/criterion families including paths, outer weights, outer loadings, Cronbach's alpha, HTMT, and R-squared.
acceptance_criteria: Representative reflective, formative, and structural PLS fixtures re-estimate every selected bootstrap subsample and return inference for each documented eligible family present.
Parameter identity remains stable across original and resampled estimates.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate bootstrap eligibility for interactions, higher-order constructs, nonlinear terms, controls, endogeneity, groups, or other difficult PLS shapes.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-version model-shape matrix records accept/reject behavior and result families for every difficult bootstrap fixture.
No advanced model shape is declared supported from the generic PLS path-model wording.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: each subsample randomly draws observations with replacement and has the original analytical sample size, or the reduced size after case-by-case deletion for missing values.
acceptance_criteria: The resampling ledger stores exactly the analytical-sample-sized index vector for every replicate and permits repeated case indices.
When case-by-case deletion is selected, every replicate size equals the post-deletion sample count and links to that reduced sample.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define resampling behavior for other missing-value treatments, sampling weights, grouped filters, matrix inputs, or categorical indicators.
acceptance_criteria: Separate official captures record the exact sampling unit and preprocessing order for every such input combination.
No weighted or pairwise-deletion bootstrap behavior is inferred from the case-resampling description.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the nonparametric procedure draws each case subsample with replacement, re-estimates the PLS model, and aggregates replicate parameter estimates for inference.
acceptance_criteria: A fixed-seed microcase reproduces every stored index vector and refitted parameter vector across repeated executions.
Changing worker count changes neither accepted replicate indices nor aligned analytical results.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: bootstrap distributions provide standard errors, t-values, confidence intervals, and significance testing for paths, outer weights, outer loadings, Cronbach's alpha, HTMT, R-squared, and other selected PLS results.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result stores original estimate, bootstrap mean where produced, standard error, t-value, interval bounds, test side, alpha, and inferential decision for every selected parameter family.
Interval output identifies percentile, studentized, or BCa and its confidence level.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate current important-versus-complete result modes, all quality-criterion families, table identifiers, failure ledgers, ordering, or precision.
acceptance_criteria: A dated complete-results capture enumerates all result modes, parameter families, tables, warnings, ordering, and export fields.
The example output families on the public page are not treated as an exhaustive current result inventory.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not specify bootstrap histograms, distribution plots, confidence-interval graphics, or chart controls.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app capture enumerates every bootstrap chart, source distribution, default parameter, controls, and export behavior; an empty inventory must be evidenced.
Every captured plot is numerically reconciled with the stored replicate ledger or canonical summary table.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify handling of nonconvergent or inadmissible replicates, retries/replacements, too-few subsamples, invalid BCa/studentized prerequisites, interruption, or cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: A dated adversarial live-app ledger records every requested, attempted, accepted, failed, retried, and replaced replicate for each failure class.
No retry or replacement semantics are assumed from the public page, and cancelled work cannot commit a partial visible result.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: researchers may use about 1,000 subsamples for an initial assessment and 10,000 for final results, choose inference settings, and use a fixed seed for repeatable results.
acceptance_criteria: An end-to-end workflow executes a 1,000-subsample exploratory run and a separate 10,000-subsample final run without overwriting either recipe or result.
Repeating the final run with the same fixed seed and settings reproduces the same resample indices and analytical output.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not document the full current setup tabs, result-mode choice, progress/cancellation UI, failure review, save/reopen, or export sequence.
acceptance_criteria: A packaged current-version live-app capture records the complete bootstrap workflow and accessible control names.
The public settings table alone does not close the desktop workflow obligation.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: consistent bootstrapping offers the same significance-testing settings as standard bootstrapping: subsamples, confidence-interval method, test type, significance level, and RNG seed, applied to PLSc estimation.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe stores each named inference setting and identifies PLSc as the estimator used in every replicate.
A consistent-bootstrap recipe cannot compile against standard uncorrected PLS estimation.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the consistent-bootstrap page names settings but does not repeat their current default values or state whether every standard-bootstrap default is inherited unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh-dialog current-version capture records every consistent-bootstrap default and compares it field-by-field with standard bootstrapping.
No default value is inherited by inference from the phrase 'same settings'.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: consistent bootstrapping is available when a model uses the PLSc-SEM algorithm and derives inference from PLSc re-estimation rather than standard PLS.
acceptance_criteria: A qualifying reflective PLSc model enables consistent bootstrapping and every replicate uses its identical correction plan.
A standard PLS-only model is rejected with a corrective instruction to select PLSc or ordinary bootstrapping.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate eligibility for mixed, interaction, higher-order, nonlinear, weighted, grouped, or other difficult PLSc models.
acceptance_criteria: A dated model-shape matrix records current live-app accept/reject behavior and result families for every difficult consistent-bootstrap fixture.
No advanced PLSc shape is accepted from the general availability statement.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: subsamples are drawn at random with replacement from the original dataset and each is re-estimated with PLSc.
acceptance_criteria: The replicate ledger stores with-replacement case-index vectors and links each vector to a PLSc refit on the same bound dataset.
The original PLSc recipe and analytical sample fingerprint are immutable inputs to the run.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify replicate sample size, missing-data treatment order, weights, groups, or input-scale restrictions.
acceptance_criteria: Dated current-version captures record each unresolved data rule before it is claimed as consistent-bootstrap parity.
Standard-bootstrap sample-size details are not silently copied into this row without official traceability.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: every bootstrap subsample is estimated using PLSc so inference reflects disattenuated, factor-consistent parameters.
acceptance_criteria: A fixed-seed oracle fixture applies the full PLSc correction independently within every replicate rather than correcting only aggregate standard-bootstrap output.
Replicate parameter alignment remains stable under sign/orientation changes.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: consistent bootstrapping yields standard errors, t-values, confidence intervals, and significance tests for PLSc results such as paths, Cronbach's alpha, HTMT, and R-squared.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result stores PLSc original estimates and matching bootstrap inference for each documented family present in the model.
Every table identifies consistent bootstrapping rather than standard bootstrapping.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page gives examples rather than an exhaustive parameter-family, table, warning, ordering, precision, or export inventory.
acceptance_criteria: A dated complete-results capture enumerates every consistent-bootstrap result family, table, warning, and export field.
No unlisted parameter family is inferred from standard bootstrapping without an exact current capture.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify consistent-bootstrap distribution charts or chart controls.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app capture enumerates all charts and their PLSc replicate sources; an empty inventory must be evidenced.
Captured chart data reconcile with the consistent-bootstrap ledger and canonical tables.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define behavior for failed PLSc corrections/refits, retries, replacements, invalid interval prerequisites, interruption, or cancellation.
acceptance_criteria: A dated adversarial live-app ledger records every requested, attempted, accepted, failed, retried, and replaced replicate and the exact user-visible diagnostic.
No standard-bootstrap failure policy is assumed and cancellation commits no partial result.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: researchers estimate a model with PLSc and then run consistent bootstrapping to obtain PLSc-based significance tests, standard errors, and confidence intervals.
acceptance_criteria: An end-to-end fixture links the completed PLSc run, consistent-bootstrap recipe, replicate ledger, inference result, archive, and export.
Changing the parent PLSc recipe invalidates the saved inference rather than reusing it.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not document the complete current setup, result mode, progress/cancellation, failure review, save/reopen, or export sequence.
acceptance_criteria: A packaged current-version live-app capture records the complete workflow and accessible control names.
The page's step-by-step support statement does not close the desktop workflow obligation.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: settings select Group A and Group B, permutation count, one- or two-tailed test, significance level, and parallel processing.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe stores two distinct declared groups, permutation count, test side, alpha, and processing mode.
Changing test side changes the p-value computation contract and is preserved in results and exports.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: defaults are 1,000 permutations, a two-tailed test, significance level 0.05, and enabled parallel processing.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh permutation recipe resolves to 1,000 runs, two-tailed, alpha 0.05, and parallel processing enabled.
Run Details and archive persist those values even when the processing mode does not alter scientific output.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the routine compares two predefined groups in a PLS-SEM model for group differences and supports MICOM measurement-invariance assessment.
acceptance_criteria: A two-group PLS fixture runs both permutation MGA and MICOM under one recipe while keeping their result sections distinct.
Group A and Group B use the same scientific model and parameter identities.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page gives example parameter families but does not enumerate all eligible model shapes, parameters, more-than-two-group workflows, interactions, higher-order constructs, or weights.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app model/parameter matrix records current eligibility and exact diagnostics for every difficult fixture and group-count boundary.
Pairwise or omnibus support beyond the documented Group A versus Group B workflow is not inferred.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the input consists of the PLS dataset plus two predefined data groups; if group selectors are empty, groups must first be generated from the dataset.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight resolves stable Group A and Group B definitions, labels, inclusion counts, and non-overlapping member rows before resampling.
An empty group selection blocks execution and directs the user to create/select dataset groups.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define missing group labels, overlapping filters, empty/tiny groups, extreme imbalance, weights, or missing-data treatment.
acceptance_criteria: A dated adversarial live-app ledger records the exact outcome for every listed group/data boundary.
No filtering, overlap resolution, or weight behavior is invented from the group-selection description.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: every run draws without replacement n observations for Group A, where n is Group A's original size, assigns all remaining observations to Group B, and therefore preserves both group sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Every permutation ledger entry contains each pooled observation exactly once and preserves the original Group A and Group B counts.
A fixed-seed reference implementation reproduces aligned null distributions under row and declaration reordering.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: one results report includes permutation MGA differences for group-specific estimates such as outer weights, outer loadings, and paths, plus MICOM measurement-invariance outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result has separate stable sections for group-specific estimates, parameter differences/permutation inference, and MICOM outcomes.
Every value identifies Group A, Group B, test side, alpha, permutation count, and source model/run.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate all parameters, MICOM tables/steps, confidence intervals, p-value columns, ordering, precision, warnings, or exports.
acceptance_criteria: A dated complete-results capture enumerates every permutation and MICOM table, column, decision, warning, ordering, and export field.
The public examples are not treated as the exhaustive result schema.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not specify permutation distributions, group-comparison plots, MICOM charts, or controls.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app capture enumerates every chart, null-distribution source, selected parameter/group, defaults, and export behavior; an empty inventory must be evidenced.
Every captured chart reconciles to the same permutation ledger and canonical table.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: an empty group selector requires the researcher to generate data groups before running the comparison.
acceptance_criteria: No-group and one-group fixtures fail preflight with an action that opens or identifies group creation/selection.
No permutation starts until two valid groups are resolved.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define behavior for failed group fits, invariance ineligibility, invalid permutations, retries/replacements, interruption, cancellation, or extreme imbalance.
acceptance_criteria: A dated adversarial live-app ledger records every requested, attempted, accepted, failed, retried, and replaced permutation and exact diagnostic.
No retry/replacement behavior is inferred, and cancellation commits no partial result.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: researchers create/select Group A and Group B, configure the permutation test, compare group-specific PLS estimates, and review both MGA and MICOM in the result report; 500-1,000 runs may be used initially and about 5,000 for final results.
acceptance_criteria: An end-to-end fixture creates/selects two groups, runs a 1,000-permutation initial analysis and a separate 5,000-permutation final analysis, and opens both MGA and MICOM sections.
Save/reopen and export preserve group identities, settings, ledger, and source run.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not document all current group-builder actions, setup tabs, progress/cancellation states, failure review, result navigation, comparison actions, or exports.
acceptance_criteria: A packaged current-version live-app capture records the complete workflow and accessible control names.
The public settings and FAQ text do not close the desktop workflow obligation.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: consistent permutation offers the standard permutation settings—group selection, permutation count, test type, significance level, and parallel processing—applied to PLSc estimation.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe stores the named group and inference settings and identifies PLSc as the estimator for every permutation.
A consistent-permutation recipe cannot compile against standard uncorrected PLS.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page names the settings but does not repeat current default values or prove that every standard-permutation default is inherited unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh-dialog current-version capture records every consistent-permutation default and compares it field-by-field with standard permutation.
No default is copied solely from the phrase 'same settings'.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: consistent permutation compares predefined groups for PLSc-SEM parameter differences and supports MICOM measurement invariance using PLSc estimates.
acceptance_criteria: A qualifying grouped PLSc model runs group comparison and MICOM with the identical PLSc correction plan in every permutation.
A standard PLS-only grouped model is rejected with a corrective instruction.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate group-count limits, mixed models, interactions, higher-order constructs, nonlinear terms, weights, or other difficult PLSc shapes.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-version shape matrix records accept/reject behavior and exact diagnostics for every difficult consistent-permutation fixture.
No advanced or more-than-two-group support is inferred from the general group-comparison description.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: observations from predefined groups are the input to random reassignment without replacement for PLSc-based comparison.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight records stable group definitions, labels, inclusion counts, member rows, PLSc recipe, and dataset fingerprint.
Every permutation consumes the same pooled eligible observations and model parameter identities.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define overlapping/empty/tiny groups, imbalance, missing group labels, missing-data treatment, weights, or scale restrictions.
acceptance_criteria: A dated adversarial live-app ledger captures the exact outcome for every listed group/data boundary.
No standard-permutation data policy is copied without exact official traceability for the consistent workflow.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: observations are randomly reassigned between groups without replacement and every run re-estimates the model with PLSc to form the null distribution of group differences.
acceptance_criteria: Every permutation assigns each pooled observation once and executes the complete PLSc correction within both permuted groups.
A fixed-seed oracle reproduces orientation-aligned null distributions under row and declaration reordering.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: results include PLSc-based multigroup comparison and MICOM measurement-invariance outcomes using disattenuated factor-consistent parameter estimates.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result has separate stable sections for PLSc group estimates, difference inference, and MICOM and labels all as consistent permutation.
Every output links to groups, settings, PLSc recipe, permutation ledger, and source dataset.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate parameters, MICOM steps, tables, p-value columns, intervals, warnings, ordering, precision, or exports.
acceptance_criteria: A dated complete-results capture enumerates every consistent-permutation and MICOM table, column, decision, warning, and export field.
The public summary does not close the complete result schema.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify PLSc permutation distributions, group-comparison plots, MICOM charts, or controls.
acceptance_criteria: A dated live-app capture enumerates every chart and its PLSc null-distribution source, defaults, controls, and export behavior; an empty inventory must be evidenced.
Every chart reconciles to the same permutation ledger and canonical table.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not define failed PLSc group refits/corrections, MICOM ineligibility, retries/replacements, invalid groups, interruption, cancellation, or extreme imbalance.
acceptance_criteria: A dated adversarial live-app ledger records every requested, attempted, accepted, failed, retried, and replaced permutation and exact diagnostic.
No standard-permutation failure policy is assumed, no uncorrected fallback is allowed, and cancellation commits no partial result.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: researchers run a multigroup comparison on a PLSc model, configure the standard permutation choices, and review both multigroup and MICOM results based on PLSc estimates.
acceptance_criteria: An end-to-end fixture links the completed PLSc model, two group definitions, consistent-permutation recipe, ledger, MGA/MICOM result, archive, and export.
Changing the PLSc recipe or either group invalidates the saved comparison rather than reusing it.

acceptance_criteria: A packaged current-version live-app capture records the complete workflow and accessible control names.
The page's step-by-step support statement does not close the desktop workflow obligation.
